do.say: The air is colder here, and still. The oldest coffins lie heaped like driftwood.

interact.look: The lid has been forced from within. The splinters point outward, and the earth inside is fresh.
A stake of ash, black to the grain at the point.
interact.take_text: The point is stained to the grain. Whoever drove it here was too slow, or too weak, or too late. I take it, and I will not be any of those.

interact.look: Walled in long ago with new mortar over old. From the other side, if I hold my breath, there is a sound like a slow, patient scratching.
